BiblicalUsage: The word means to empty out, to lay waste, and Isaiah uses it when the Lord empties the earth and turns it upside down, scattering its inhabitants.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a wasted earth is not an accident but a judgment, and Isaiah says it plainly so no one mistakes it for bad luck.
